system.flavor: Tilt the ground and shove the target where you want it.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Pull or push the target up to 2 units.

surges.html: The ground the target occupied becomes difficult until the start of your next turn. Movement through it costs 1 additional per unit.
The target suffers -1 Defense against the next attack made against it before the start of your next turn.
The point becomes difficult ground until your next turn. Movement through it costs +1 per unit.

rider.title: SPACE - THREAD
rider.html: Create a Space Thread. Before resolving a future Magecraft Action that moves a creature, consume it to increase that forced movement by 1 unit.
